subject.title: fix(reef): contain startup friend reconcile failures

question: Should Reef prioritize availability by activating after a classified transient startup reconcile failure, using persisted peer keys until the next reconcile interval?
rationale: The patch is mechanically coherent, but whether temporarily stale peer keys are acceptable for an encrypted inter-agent channel is an intentional product and delivery policy choice rather than a testable implementation detail.

options.title: Accept availability-first startup
options.body: Allow only classified transient relay and transport failures to be reported while Reef activates with persisted peer keys and retries on the normal interval.

options.title: Fail startup on all reconcile failures
options.body: Preserve the current strict startup requirement, accepting supervisor restart pressure during relay throttling.

recommendation.title: Accept availability-first startup
recommendation.body: Allow only classified transient relay and transport failures to be reported while Reef activates with persisted peer keys and retries on the normal interval.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent merged lifecycle recovery work and current branch commits show the strongest ownership signal for the Reef availability policy.
